title: New Vigilant Solutions Channel Program Offers Incentives Including Discounts and Share of Recurring Revenue for Distribution Partners
summary: Vigilant Solutions, a Motorola Solutions company, announced a new worldwide Channel Partner Program offering resellers discounts, lead management, marketing funds, and a share of recurring revenue to distribute its LPR, analytics, and facial recognition products to law enforcement.

key_quotes.quote: Vigilant Solutions invites qualified resellers to join the company's new worldwide Channel Partner Program backed by sales incentives, lead management, marketing funds and share of recurring revenue to support distribution of Vigilant's license plate recognition (LPR), analytics and facial recognition technology to the public safety market.
